description: This file contains JUnit 5 test cases for the RoleValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation of Role objects including role name and description fields.

classes.name: RoleValidatorTest
classes.description: Test suite for RoleValidator class validating Role entity constraints.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRoleIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Tests that the validator correctly flags null, empty, or whitespace-only roles.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfDescriptionIsNullOrEmptyOrWhitespace
methods.description: Ensures that description fields with null, empty, or whitespace are accepted without errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfRoleHasLeadingOrTrailingSpace
methods.description: Checks that roles with leading or trailing spaces trigger validation errors with specific error code.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfAllRequiredFieldsHaveProperValues
methods.description: Verifies that valid role data passes without validation errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Confirms that fields within acceptable length limits do not produce errors.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Tests that overlong role or description fields trigger validation errors.
